(Source: Lynes, 1999)

remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature" [note of inscription 2, but in Whitney Archive as by O'Keeffe]. Abiquiú Notebooks notes inscription 1 once. Pictured in 1935 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 59, 60. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, backing inscription 2.
titles.title: White Pansy

description: A white pansy with hints of purple and a yellow center fills the frame. Tiny periwinkle flowers dot the edges of the work. Its background is rendered in shades of light purple and white.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Cleveland Museum of Art.
title: White Pansy
